description: This file defines the ConditionDAO interface in Java, which declares database access methods for Condition objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting Condition records based on various criteria like ID, UUID, patient, or encounter.

classes.name: ConditionDAO
classes.description: Java interface for database operations related to Condition objects, including retrieval, saving, and deletion.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition object based on its UUID.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Fetches all active conditions linked to a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Gets all conditions associated with a specific patient (see mention of org.openmrs.api.ConditionService).

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves all conditions associated with a specific encounter; may throw APIException.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Persists a Condition object to the database and returns the saved object.

methods.name: deleteCondition
methods.description: Removes a Condition object from the database; may throw DAOException.
